prompts: Use case: stylized-concept, cinematic photorealistic sci-fi. Edit the reference ECHO-9 combat robot. User requests SOME SHARPER EDGES and MORE COLOR. Preserve the same athletic humanlike proportions, full protective warfare suit, enclosed helmet with cyan visor, rifle held low in both hands, shoulder-mounted launcher, tactical backpack, holstered sidearm, sheathed blade, and full head-to-toe framing. Refine the armor with deliberate crisp chamfered edges, angular overlapping layered plates, sharp beveled ridges along shoulders, breastplate, gauntlets, knees and shins. Mix strong angular edge definition with the existing sculpted flowing anatomy; don't turn the robot into stacked boxes and don't add spikes. Make the colors visibly richer and intentional: saturated deep cobalt-blue painted ceramic armor as the main color across shoulders, outer chest, forearms, thigh shells and shins; clean warm ivory contrasting inset armor on chest center, helmet cheeks, upper arms and inner leg panels; bold crimson-red accent armor on shoulder tips, chest trim, knee guards and selected helmet panels; graphite/titanium flexible joints; a few restrained brushed-brass mechanical trim details; narrow cyan visor and subtle cyan status lights. Balanced premium military sci-fi color blocking, visible blue and red even in shadow, physically real painted materials, realistic fine edge wear revealing metal and modest scuffs, not rainbow and not toy plastic. Color placement coherent and asymmetrically marked only with small painted identification stripes, no text. Fully covered torso, pelvis, limbs and boot toes, no naked exposed mechanical muscles except narrow joint articulation gaps. Futuristic rifle shares cobalt, ivory and graphite palette with a little crimson trim. Photorealistic live-action Transformers-inspired VFX quality, rugged believable mechanical detail, substantial armor thickness. Keep same front three-quarter relaxed low-ready stance in vast military spacecraft hangar. Broad neutral key light makes colors and armor details clear, gentle warm rim light, cinematic background softly out of focus, natural reflections. Portrait 2:3 full-body hero photograph, entire helmet and boots inside frame with margins. No other characters, no text, no watermark.

Create a landscape 3:2 photorealistic sci-fi character modeling turnaround sheet of EXACTLY the fully armored ECHO-9 robot in the supplied reference. Six whole-body photographs in a 3-column by 2-row layout, small labels FRONT, LEFT, REAR, RIGHT, HIGH ANGLE, LOW ANGLE. Preserve exact full combat suit, enclosed swept helmet with cyan visor, humanlike athletic proportions, narrow waist, fitted plate armor, crisp chamfered angular edges combined with sculpted curved anatomy. EXACT same saturated cobalt-blue primary armor, ivory inset plates, crimson-red shoulder, helmet and knee accents, graphite joints and subtle brass trim; same color placement in all views. Preserve rifle held low in two hands, shoulder launcher above robot's right shoulder, tactical backpack, pistol holster on right thigh, sheathed blade on left hip, belt pouches; equipment stays on the same anatomical sides. Rear views show compact armored tactical backpack with credible mounting and armor following human shoulder blades. Fully protected torso, pelvis, thighs, shins and closed armored boots, no naked mechanical muscle surfaces except narrow joint gaps. Neutral relaxed stance, full helmet to boots visible with margins, identical model scale. True side-on profiles, elevated front three-quarter and low rear three-quarter. Clean charcoal industrial photography bay, floor with soft contact shadows, broad neutral studio light keeps strong colors and machinery clear. Live-action Transformers VFX realism, real painted composite armor with small scratches and fine edge wear, no toy plastic, no stacked boxes, no skin. Minimal labels only, no watermark.

Create a landscape 3:2 premium photorealistic sci-fi modeling detail sheet of EXACTLY the fully armored ECHO-9 robot in the supplied reference. Six large macro photographs in a 3-column by 2-row layout. Panels: HELMET showing enclosed helmet with crisp beveled cobalt/red/ivory plates, cyan optical visor, armored jaw; TORSO showing cobalt breastplate, crimson accents and ivory segmented abdominal armor with sharp layered edges; BACK / LAUNCHER showing tactical backpack and right-shoulder compact launcher; RIFLE / HANDS showing exact cobalt/graphite/ivory rifle with crimson trim held by armored gauntlets; HIP EQUIPMENT showing armored pelvis, belt pouches, secured right-thigh pistol and left-hip sheathed blade; BOOTS / KNEES showing red kneecaps, cobalt/ivory beveled shin shells and closed armored boots. Keep identity, proportions, exact armor design, saturated color blocking and equipment from reference. Strong crisp chamfered armor edges over natural humanlike anatomy; no cubes, oversized box shoulders, exposed naked mechanical muscle body, unhelmeted face, or human skin. Extraordinary realistic ceramic paint, metal, believable thickness and joints, subtle chips, scuffs and dust. Live-action Transformers film VFX quality, naturally reflective surfaces, sharp detailed camera photography, neutral broad key lighting makes colors readable; gently blurred hangar background. Small restrained labels as specified. No other text or watermark.
